reviewed_scope.scope: Recheck the 13 previous design findings; no replacement code or migrations.

prior_finding_resolutions.evidence: Per-edge ledger, unique(id,owner_id), mixed/public triggers and staff exceptions now present; DB2-01 and DB2-04 remain.
Deferred conversation/revision/subject/contract lineage and FactPredicate cardinality are explicit; DB2-02 and DB2-05 remain.
ContentType, AdminLogEntry, native field/PK layouts and typed legacy target keys now represented; DB2-03 remains.
UsageEntry has stable posting_key unique per owner, exact event/assessment provenance and locked bounded reversals; assessments have immutable numbered supersession.
Selective assertion/message scope, Artifact kinds, ContentCopy closure and owner erasure-generation fencing added; DB2-04 remains.
Default no-reuse and explicit scoped grant/revocation added; exact imported-assertion lineage DB2-05 remains.
ExpenseLine.service_extent plus evidenced/stipulated ExpenseAllocation supports an instant boundary without invented midnight.
Clinician identity, observation kind/value and negative-search completeness now represented; insurer-independent branch facts need DB2-06.
Rule and SearchChunk uniqueness includes owner with NULLS NOT DISTINCT, preserving public dedup and private owner separation.
Duration known/unknown/not_applicable alternatives added; absolute-limit percentage base and absent waiting credit may be explicit null.

Temporal formats/precision, operator arity, event payload requirements and dimension-keyed reconciliation tightened; explicit versioned semantic publication checks cover relational and unit obligations.
246 FK action records and explicit erasure ordering now exist; global-target owner predicates and native ORM-versus-SQL actions need DB2-01/03.
ExpenseAllocation models package parent, time/scope portions, source/status and separate accounting roles with conservation/cycle validation.

findings.title: Generated owner predicates are invalid for globally scoped targets and incomplete for a nullable source.
findings.issue: 24 public_only relationships propose target.owner_id IS NULL even though those target entities have no owner_id field. ModelAttempt.turn_id is same_owner but the source ModelAttempt.owner_id is nullable, so its composite equality FK alone can skip checking a referenced private Turn. The prose NOT NULL owner is not an executable conditional constraint and cannot be unconditional on mixed public processing attempts.
findings.fix: Use ordinary typed FKs for physically global targets; use public-owner predicates only on mixed targets. Add an explicit CHECK turn_id IS NULL OR owner_id IS NOT NULL and retain composite ownership checking for a turn parent. Validate mixed processing-job parent ownership as well.

findings.title: Contract/provider fact subjects have no corresponding identity fields.
findings.issue: FactPredicate.subject_kind permits person,conversation,contract,provider. FactAssertion has person_id and conversation_id but no contract/provider subject reference. Two contracts or providers in one conversation therefore cannot be reliably distinguished as subjects of the same scalar predicate; placing a reference in the value would conflate subject with value.
findings.fix: Add closed typed subject identity fields/reference with exactly the required identity for each predicate subject kind and appropriate owner checks. Define scalar uniqueness/supersession against that subject identity. Alternatively explicitly limit the vocabulary to the subject kinds actually represented, with case coverage implications retained.

findings.title: Native deletion semantics need a separate ORM/SQL contract.
findings.issue: AuthPermission.content_type_id is listed NO ACTION even though the preserved native Django Permission field uses on_delete=CASCADE. Other native rows call CASCADE/SET NULL native without distinguishing the ORM collector action from the physical database FK action. Treating these labels as native SQL cascade DDL would change existing behavior. The public-only owner predicate on ContentType is separately invalid.
findings.fix: Record native Django on_delete and physical SQL FK actions separately. Preserve Permission -> ContentType ORM CASCADE and the actual native physical constraint semantics. Mark framework relationships as native role-limited FKs without fabricated owner columns. This is a design mapping correction, not authorization to change native constraints.

findings.title: Copy ownership contract permits a private disclosure to target a public artifact.
findings.issue: ContentCopy.source_artifact_id and destination_artifact_id both say Same owner in the dictionary but are public_or_same_owner in the relationship ledger. In particular a private fact source plus a public destination passes the listed access predicates, contrary to the private-copy and selective-erasure boundary.
findings.fix: Require the destination artifact owner to equal the ContentCopy owner for private content copies; define whether public-source-to-private derivative is permitted separately. Never allow private source content to produce an owner-NULL destination through this registry. Keep copy closure registration and generation fencing.

findings.title: An imported fact does not identify its exact source assertion.
findings.issue: The grant may list several assertion IDs, but the imported FactAssertion only records import_grant_id. There is no separate source_assertion_id. Reusing supersedes_id would treat a copied assertion as correction of the source conversation, mix two lineage concepts and conflict with ordinary same-conversation supersession rules.
findings.fix: Add an explicit import source assertion FK, required only for authorized_import, validate source membership in the grant and source/destination conversation match, and preserve supersedes_id solely for correction lineage. Revoke/erase dependent copies through the exact source edge.

findings.title: Insurer-independent accessibility facts still require an insurer.
findings.issue: The new wheelchair_access kind represents a physical branch property but insurer_id remains mandatory. A directly evidenced accessible entrance with no insurer context requires invented insurer attribution or unnecessary per-insurer duplication. Network/exclusion and authorization observations do require insurer context.
findings.fix: Make insurer_id optional with kind-specific requirements and scope checks: mandatory for insurer-specific observations, absent/explicitly optional for branch or clinician facts. Retain provider identity, dated evidence and completeness.

pending_parent_additions.assessment: Needed to resolve the preserved-unmapped payload locator gap. Add the FK to the relationship ledger with exact owner/public scope. Coverage/original-citation eligibility must require acquired_original, not merely media_type or a source hash; archival source rows and processing derivatives cannot count as insurer original evidence. Validate the locator against archive hashes and preserve private ownership. Recheck after insertion; no claim this change is already implemented.

positive_findings: The original 13 problems were addressed substantively; six are closed at proposal level and seven have narrower residuals.
No database implementation approval is claimed.
Exact quantity and temporal states preserve uncertainty; numeric or schema validity does not become insurance acceptance.
Erasure closure, copy registration, stable posting keys and immutable assessment revisions now have concrete representations.
verification_limit: Read-only proposal inspection and in-memory JSON Schema probes only. No Django setup/checks, database constraints, migrations, services, customer rows, secrets or app code were exercised. Proposed triggers and RLS still require implementation-phase concurrency and erasure tests after design approval.
